scope.fixtures: Exact saved legacy shapes, equipment and cargo; current migration applied directly to cloned public design data; one stats/profile build per design.
scope.steadyState: Thermal equilibrium is not inferred from installed rating; sustained output remains undetermined.
scope.runtime: Full throttle; cold healthy initial modules; no shots requested; cruise/balanced/weapons/shields allocation modes.
scope.snapshot: Each design uses the immutable VM source loaded at start; source hashes identify that exact calculation, including when later unrelated edits occur.
